name: A loose invitation
description: A careless socialite offers a small opening and a first chance to earn your name.
successText: A quiet win. Your name travels a little farther tonight.
failureText: The moment passes badly. Someone recognizes your crew's presence.

name: The pawnshop claim
description: A disputed collection sits in a shuttered pawnshop. Mara wants the matter settled.
successText: The collection changes hands. Mara calls the neighborhood debt settled.
failureText: The claim draws an audience. You leave without a payout.

name: The missing sedan
description: A collector pays for the return of a car whose ownership is bitterly disputed.
successText: The collector receives the sedan. The dispute is now someone else's.
failureText: The sedan never reaches its destination. Your part in the argument becomes public.

name: Favors come due
description: An old acquaintance owes a share of a deal. Choose how much pressure your name should carry.
successText: The debt is settled with a promise to do better next time.
failureText: The conversation becomes a grievance. You gain attention instead of money.

name: Mara's envelope
description: A private message needs a reliable courier. The favor matters more than its contents.
successText: The envelope arrives. Mara now has one more reason to trust you.
failureText: The meeting dissolves before you arrive. Mara will have to arrange it again.

name: Warehouse opportunity
description: An abandoned warehouse holds a disputed windfall. A rival claim makes this your first serious risk.
successText: The warehouse claim pays out. The city notices a new contender.
failureText: A rival crew reaches the claim first. You escape the confrontation with a costly lesson.

name: The tide account
description: Rafe offers a share in a disputed private consignment. Dock politics decide the margin.
successText: The consignment closes with your share intact. Rafe nods in approval.
failureText: The port dispute halts the deal. Your deposit vanishes into legal claims.

name: Pier guarantee
description: A dock business needs someone to keep a bitter dispute from becoming worse.
successText: The crews agree to a cooling-off period. Your guarantee holds.
failureText: Neither side listens. Your promise becomes an expensive obligation.

name: Night manifest
description: A delayed contract needs a personal handover before the harbor shift changes.
successText: The contract arrives on time. The dock office remembers the favor.
failureText: The deadline passes. The disappointed client asks someone else next time.

name: Dock runner
description: A transport dispute puts a rare utility vehicle within a valuable claim.
successText: The vehicle reaches its claimant. Your fee reflects the difficult night.
failureText: Ownership arguments spill into the street. The job ends without a winner.

name: Disputed cargo
description: Two crews claim the same storage lot. Rafe offers you a share for taking the risk.
successText: Your crew settles the warehouse claim. The harbor talks about it for days.
failureText: The rival claim is stronger than expected. Your crew takes the loss together.

name: Berth payout
description: A corrupt broker's windfall is available for one brief night. The docks will judge the result.
successText: The broker loses a windfall. Your own account looks healthier.
failureText: The broker raises a public complaint. Your reputation takes the blame.

name: Velvet winnings
description: A famous gambler's careless night creates a lucrative opening among difficult company.
successText: The evening ends with a private profit. The Velvet Circle takes note.
failureText: The gambler's circle notices the loss before your exit. Your night becomes expensive.

name: Penthouse keepsake
description: A valuable keepsake sits at the heart of a personal feud. The client will pay to end it.
successText: The keepsake returns to its claimant. You receive a discreet, generous fee.
failureText: The feud draws unwanted witnesses. You leave with a story nobody likes.

name: A table debt
description: Ivo's wealthy guest has stopped answering calls. A calm conversation could restore the balance.
successText: The guest settles the account. Ivo saves face and you gain standing.
failureText: The guest turns the meeting into a public insult. Ivo needs time to repair it.

name: The club promise
description: A new venue needs your name behind its opening night. Promises made here carry a price.
successText: The opening night passes without a crisis. Your name becomes part of the venue's success.
failureText: An argument ruins the opening. Your guarantee leaves you covering the damage.

name: Silver coupe
description: An extravagant vehicle becomes the prize in a bitter partnership breakup.
successText: The coupe changes hands. Your discreet fee is anything but modest.
failureText: The partnership dispute turns into a city-wide complaint. The payout disappears.

name: The gala purse
description: A private gala holds a disputed prize fund. Your crew can stake a claim on its last night.
successText: The gala ends with your crew holding the prize. Invitations begin arriving from better rooms.
failureText: The private dispute becomes public spectacle. The crew leaves under heavy scrutiny.

name: Foundry surplus
description: An abandoned factory's remaining assets have rival claimants. Lin wants a decisive settlement.
successText: The factory claim is settled. Your crew's standing in Ironworks grows.
failureText: The rival crew refuses to concede. You retreat with losses and injured pride.

name: The furnace account
description: A private industrial consignment promises an exceptional margin and an uncertain partner.
successText: The partnership survives the night. The margin rewards your judgment.
failureText: The partner breaks the agreement. Your investment becomes a hard lesson.

name: Union guarantee
description: A workers' meeting needs a respected guarantor while rival interests circle.
successText: The meeting holds. Lin remembers that your word protected a fragile peace.
failureText: The negotiations collapse. Your name becomes part of the blame.

name: Executive claims
description: A former director holds disputed company valuables. A claimant asks your crew to settle the score.
successText: The valuables return to the claimant. Your share buys more than a few quiet nights.
failureText: The director's allies close ranks. The unresolved claim leaves you exposed.

name: Midnight contract
description: An industrial agreement needs a trusted messenger before the board changes its mind.
successText: The agreement arrives in time. The industrial board now knows your name.
failureText: The vote passes without the agreement. You lose a valuable introduction.

name: The factory fund
description: A closed factory's private reserve is the object of a major dispute. Your crew can change the outcome.
successText: The reserve changes hands. Ironworks sees your crew as a serious power.
failureText: The fund slips away while rival interests turn against you. The aftermath will be costly.

name: The Regency token
description: A coveted private token grants more status than its owner deserves. Its rival claimant offers a fortune.
successText: The token changes hands. The Regency begins to question who belongs at the top.
failureText: The token remains where it was. The city's elite remembers your failed claim.

name: Crown fleet
description: An exclusive collector offers a premium for settling a disputed luxury vehicle claim.
successText: The collector takes possession. Your crew earns a fee with several zeroes.
failureText: The claim meets powerful resistance. The fleet stays in the original hands.

name: Dynastic debt
description: A powerful family owes a private account. Selene needs a conversation that changes their priorities.
successText: The family settles quietly. Selene respects the restraint as much as the result.
failureText: The family refuses the claim and closes its doors. Your standing suffers.

name: Private consignment
description: A private exchange offers a rich share in disputed luxury goods. The partners expect discretion.
successText: The exchange completes. The city's most selective circles take your business seriously.
failureText: The private exchange fractures. Your deposit and standing take the damage.

name: Skyline collection
description: A contested art collection could settle years of rivalry. Your crew is offered a substantial stake.
successText: The collection's claim is settled in your client's favor. Your influence reaches the skyline.
failureText: The art dispute attracts too much attention. Your crew leaves without its share.

name: Regent treasury
description: A private syndicate reserve presents a final district challenge before the Meridian operation.
successText: The reserve falls to your crew's claim. Crown Heights can no longer overlook your name.
failureText: The Regency holds the reserve. Your crew absorbs a bruising, very public loss.
